items.title: Bela Fleck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 7, 2004
items.q: the early Louis Armstrong music is well known

ctx.x: Just to be hanging out and witness some of that?

Yeah. A lot of the jazz eras, but also a lot of the bluegrass eras. It would have been great to see Bill Monroe, and Flatt & Scruggs playing together in their original bluegrass band. And also a lot of the earlier music before that, the early Louis Armstrong music is well known but a lot of other music that was happening around that time and then the slaves music, the music that was being played on banjos that the Africans that were brought over were playing. A big part of what I’m doing next year, I’m going to…
